info.name: Revoshop API
info.description:
Revoshop e-commerce backend API, organized by user role. Each role folder (Admin, Buyer, Seller) contains EVERY endpoint that role is authorized to call. Endpoints a role cannot access (would return 403) are omitted from that folder. Shared no-auth endpoints live in the Public folder.

Each role folder has its own Login request that stores a role-scoped bearer token (adminToken / buyerToken / sellerToken), applied automatically to every request in the folder. Requests include saved example responses for a happy path and a failure case.

Setup: run the API at http://127.0.0.1:5000, seed the database, then run the Login in the role folder you want before other requests.

item.name: Admin
item.description: Every endpoint an admin is authorized to call. Run 'Login (Admin)' first.
